field.comment: Unpadded base64url opaque handle, if sent by authenticator.
field.name: userHandle

field.comment: Untrusted browser assertion envelope; verifier must parse and validate every field.
field.name: responseJson

field.comment: Only true after complete validation; caller must still consume ceremony and update credential atomically.
field.name: verified

field.comment: Mirror Java result.valid; only true permits atomic ceremony consume and counter update or login.
field.name: valid

field.comment: INVALID_RESPONSE, VERIFICATION_FAILED or INVALID_STORED_KEY on invalid verdict; null on success.
field.name: reason

field.comment: Verified credential ID, only on success.
field.name: credentialId

field.comment: SPKI or COSE, from trusted stored key format; only on success.
field.name: publicKeyFormat

field.comment: ES256 or RS256, derived from validated stored key; only on success.
field.name: algorithm
